Art Director's Son Arrested, Granted Bail in Hyderabad Hit-and-Run Case

Sandeep Anand, son of Tollywood art director Anand Sai and an aide of Pawan Kalyan, was arrested in connection with a fatal hit-and-run incident in Hyderabad. He was subsequently granted bail. The incident involved a crash resulting in a fatality. Anand Sai is a popular art director in the Telugu film industry.
